name.description: the chatbot's display name in the window header (plain text, no logo)

turns.description: the exchange in order; each turn appears on its own keyword

who.description: the speaker label shown over the turn; a turn whose who equals the bot name is the bot's, any other is the user's. A directed lesson needs a turn of each side (lint error otherwise), and who is never a part of the prompt such as a role or a task
